238. Preparation of development plan.—

—   (1) Every Panchayat shall prepare every 
year a development plan and submit it to the Zilla Panchayat before such date and in such 
form as may be prescribed. 
(2) Every Zilla Panchayat shall prepare every year, a development plan of the district 
after including the development plans of Panchayats and submit it to the District Planning 
Committee constituted under section 239.
